passages.text: Sphenopus divaricatus is a species of grass in the family Poaceae (true grasses). It is an annual native to the Mediterranean Basin countries of North Africa, southern Europe, and western Asia and eastwards to Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Pakistan.
